sentences.en: Americans are becoming more adventurous in their food choices.
sentences.zh: 美国人在食物选择上变得越来越喜欢冒险。

sentences.en: I'm not adventurous enough to try doing that.
sentences.zh: 我不够大胆去尝试做那个。

sentences.en: For starters, millenials are more adventurous and want to try something new.
sentences.zh: 以开始为例，千禧一代更喜欢冒险，想要尝试一些新的东西。

senses.zh: 爱冒险的 - 大胆的；敢做敢为的 - 充满危险的
